//: xterm.js is a BROWSER terminal, and its public API names DOM types — HTMLElement, KeyboardEvent, WheelEvent. This package exists to be API-compatible with it, so those names have to typecheck even though carbon has no DOM. That is why this tsconfig exists rather than the package joining solutions/tsconfig.json: it needs lib DOM, and lib DOM must NOT leak into the rest of the tree, where a stray `document.` would then compile and fail at runtime.
